entities.name: Sanctum of the Sun
entities.description: Legendary building deep within Orazca locked behind Azor's Gateway, created by Azor.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: Golden city of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Planeswalker who made the Immortal Sun and sealed himself in the Sanctum.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Azor made by sacrificing his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker who never sent the signal.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who discovered the Sanctum and sentenced Azor.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to kill Azor.

events.summary: Azor sacrifices his spark to make the Immortal Sun and retreats to the Sanctum awaiting his plan to trap Bolas.
events.quote: After sacrificing his planeswalker spark to make the Immortal Sun , Azor retreated to this sanctum

events.summary: Ugin never sends the signal and Azor remains trapped on the plane.
events.quote: Ugin never sent the signal, and Azor remained isolated, his purpose unfulfilled.

events.summary: Jace discovers and opens the Sanctum and enters with Vraska.
events.quote: Jace Beleren later discovered it and opened it to enter the inner Sanctum along with Vraska .

events.summary: Vraska tries to kill Azor but Jace stops her.
events.quote: Vraska tried to kill him for disrupting the balance of countless planes, but Jace stopped her.

events.summary: Jace, as Living Guildpact, sentences Azor to solitude on Useless Island.
events.quote: he sentenced Azor to spend his life in solitude on Useless Island
